items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: We were at Cafe Society with J.C. Heard's band and Al McKibbon and Joe Newman

ctx.x: Oh yeah, we were talkin' about piano players. Jimmy Jones. We were at Cafe Society with J.C. Heard's band and Al McKibbon and Joe Newman and before that was George Treadwell and when Sarah came in ...I became aware of her when I was in Earl Hines' Band, because they were excited about this young girl that won the award at the Apollo Theater, you know. Everybody was excited about her.
You were in Earl Hines' Band when she (Sarah Vaughan) started?
